methodology: Actual local Vite source. Controlled states use existing engine exports and an in-memory response hook on loadActive; no source files edited. Network is isolated, preferences muted, normal motion enabled. Leaderboard rows are synthetic demonstration data. Game over is reached through an unmodified, replayable practice run.
